what: Letters and panel shadows that look pressed into cardboard move with scroll — emboss: the shadow is flattened to 0px and offset by 3 and 8px, then at 88% of the screen it stamps into place over 1.1s power3.out as the shadow returns (once). crease: a fold line is drawn from the left at 92% of the screen over 1.3s power2.inOut. press: with a big lifted shadow, 1.035x and 3px above, it presses in bound to scroll from 92% to 48% of the screen. rake: a shadow cast by light from the opposite side (flipped horizontally) turns into its own shadow from the screen bottom up to 30%

options.x · y: Distance (px) the emboss sits offset, default 3 · 8
options.lift: Variable name on the consuming side used for the press lifted shadow (like --rv-sh-10). If absent, the resting shadow distance is tripled

use: Your title here

from.where: index.html section titles · quotes · footer cells (emboss) · cardboard rows · FAQ rows · footer fold line (crease) · price (press, lift: --rv-sh-10) · footer wordmark (rake) — original motion effects · effectTriggers

note: For elements without a shadow, the emboss is offset by 3·8px and only the incoming one applies. Shadow recipes stack several layers like the original, and since the layer counts match they blend as they are
